```{=html}
<!-- ==========================================================================
     CV PAGE
     The PDF is handed to the browser's own viewer, so there is no JavaScript
     and no third-party embed. That viewer supplies its own download, print
     and zoom controls in its toolbar. Anything inside the element is the
     fallback, shown only when a browser cannot render a PDF inline (some
     mobile browsers), which is why the fallback keeps a plain link.
     ========================================================================== -->
<object class="cv-frame" data="cv/Magazinnik_CV.pdf" type="application/pdf">
  <p class="cv-fallback">Your browser cannot show PDFs inline.
  <a href="cv/Magazinnik_CV.pdf">Download the CV</a> instead.</p>
</object>
```
